title: ApprovalTicket
description: Immutable governance ticket for human-in-the-loop tool execution

actor.description: Authenticated requesting agent or user identifier

tool_name.description: Exact registered tool name to be executed

action_version.description: Semantic version of the target tool schema

args.description: Exact JSON parameter payload provided for invocation

args_hash.description: SHA-256 hash over canonical arguments preventing tampering

destination.description: Target endpoint, file path, database, or shell context

scope.description: Least-privilege operational capability scope (e.g. fs:write:/path, net:egress:host, shell:cmd)

estimated_cost_usd.description: Upper-bound financial cost estimate in USD

status.description: Current resolution status of the ticket

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp in UTC after which ticket cannot be resolved or executed

reviewer_id.description: Identifier of the human operator who reviewed the ticket

consumed.description: Single-use flag to prevent replay attacks

consumed_at.description: Timestamp when execution consumed the approved ticket

consumed_by.description: Agent identifier that consumed the ticket
